newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randgold Resources reports good results from Mali.
newsitem.headline: Randgold Resources reports good results from Mali.

text.p: Randgold Resources, due to be listed in London in June, said on Wednesday its Syama gold mine in Mali reported encouraging results for the March quarter.
The company, the exploration arm of Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd said in a statement its African exploration projects had also produced good results in the three months to end-March.
"Productivity improvement at Syama helped to slash the forecast loss for the quarter from $800,000 to $114,000," the company said.
But it said gold production dropped to 35,312 ounces in the March quarter from 41,523 in the previous quarter due to a planned plant shutdown.

It said the Syama board had given the go-ahead to a phased capital expenditure programme designed to increase production to 270,000 ounces of gold per year and reduce operating costs to around $210/oz over a two-year period.
While getting Syama on track to meet its production and cost targets, Randgold Resources was also continuing to explore other projects.
The company's resource base was now 10.5 million ounces of which 6.4 million was attributable.
"Particular emphasis is being placed on Loulo in Mali and Golden Ridge in Tanzania," the company added.
